exposure: Educational intervention (workshop with demonstrations, role-plays, laminated checklists)
outcome: Compliance with WHO Safe Childbirth Checklist (SCC)
cohort: The study observed 120 consecutive deliveries (60 pre-intervention and 60 post-intervention) at a tertiary care hospital in Lahore, Pakistan, focusing on the adherence of obstetricians, midwives, and nurses to the WHO SCC.
finding: A well-organized educational program significantly improved compliance with the WHO Safe Childbirth Checklist in the tertiary care hospital in Pakistan, with overall compliance increasing from 58.3% to 78.3%.
cross-section timing: Pre-intervention (December 1, 2023 - December 30, 2023) and post-intervention (January 1, 2024 - February 15, 2024) cycles within a prospective clinical audit.
